responsibility: This file provides IR-independent queries about target support for optab operations and related instruction patterns. It resolves direct and conversion handlers with optimization-type filtering, describes available bitfield extraction/insertion instructions, answers capability questions for widening, vector permutes, atomics, conditional moves, gather/scatter, compare-and-swap, atomic load/exchange, and caches per-target/per-function support decisions used by both tree and RTL expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implements the optabs stem's IR-agnostic query logic: it defines the querying and caching code for target_optabs state, insn-selection predicates, and capability tests. Unlike gcc/optabs-query.h, which only declares this API and helper types, this .cc file contains the executable query machinery.
